descriptions.en: This kinetic Orokin sculpture springs to life when filled with Ayatan Stars. It may also be a source of Endo.
descriptions.zh: 当这座带有活动机关的奥罗金塑像填满阿耶檀识之星时，它便会开始自主运动。此外，它也能作为内融核心的来源。

descriptions.en: Struck to commemorate the Entrati family’s power and prestige, as well as safeguarding their memories of one another. Many things changed in the years that followed, and that which had once shone brightly grew dark and dim. But even a single Ayatan Star may make all the difference.
descriptions.zh: 这尊雕像之所以被打造出来，不仅是为了纪念英择谛家族的实力与威望，同时也是为了保存家族成员之间的珍贵记忆。时过境迁，曾今闪耀的雕像现已变得暗淡无光。但只要插上一颗阿耶檀识星，它就会变得截然不同。
